# José Mondelo Álvarez

> Full-stack developer from Sanlúcar de Barrameda (Cádiz, Spain), working remote or hybrid. Sole technical lead of KNC, a SaaS platform in production for nurseries, senior care homes and sports clubs, built as one Flutter codebase for web, Android and iOS with a Firebase and AWS backend.

## Profile

- Role: Full-Stack Developer and Technical Lead at KNC (Kids and Clouds), Visasur Sistemas, since July 2025. Sole developer: frontend, backend, database, servers and app store releases.
- Main stack: Flutter 3, Dart 3, Riverpod, go_router, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions v2 in Node.js, Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics), AWS S3 and CloudFront, Holded API, SEPA direct debits. Also React, Next.js, TypeScript, Angular, Laravel and Django.
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (A2).
- Education: Higher Technical Diploma in Web Application Development (I.E.S. Doñana, 2022–2024). Prompt engineering for AI (Andalusian Digital Agency, 2025).

## KNC in numbers

- ~214,000 lines of Dart across 16 feature modules, 132 screens, 120 routes, 6 user roles, ~60 Firestore collections.
- 61 Cloud Functions, more than 100 production audit and migration scripts.
- Version 4.0 on the App Store and Google Play, 5,000+ downloads on Google Play.

## Highlights

- Migrated the data model from one centre per user to many centres per user, with per-co-admin permissions.
- Direct S3 uploads with presigned URLs, CloudFront delivery with expiring signed URLs, and native downloads on web, Android and iOS, always behind authentication.
- Real-time messaging with server-side scheduled sends and multi-device push notifications.
- Payments: SEPA direct debit files for families and invoicing to centres through the Holded API. Stripe and Fiskaly integrations prepared.
- Access control with dynamic QR codes validated on the server, and biometric sign-in (Face ID, fingerprint).
- Interactive 3D sales tours built with Three.js.
- AI-assisted development with Claude Code, project skills, hooks and verification.
